kind: Typed registered model methods, consuming original HTTP execution and retained method provenance

implementation.application: meden-app::model::Bound freezes role, complete method descriptor, original labels and both actual port schemas before constructing the borrowed session caller. Every reply checks the original method before dispatch and after complete return. Construction and metadata grant no authority.
implementation.http: Backend-owned Deserialize/Serialize/JsonSchema configuration, an explicit host Registry and Wire encoder/decoder. Built-in Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages use that registry. Additional native formats require no core or viewer branch. The common fixed Bearer HTTP executor consumes only the original HttpCall for endpoint/model/credential and verifies its original selected-wire identity. No retries, proxy or redirects.
implementation.binding: Original configuration/schema/implementation, route, non-authority headers and model-listing capability are frozen and rechecked. A partial, ignored, truncated or oversized body cannot admit a complete reply/tool-call vector.
implementation.history: Meaning records retain original translator/judge descriptors. Frozen reviewed repair bytes and repair logs retain the proposing method. Save checks include those original descriptor values. Older records with no descriptors remain unknown; the descriptor cannot restore a grant.
implementation.local: Original LocalCall.consume_for and confined local execution remain. Diagnostic descriptor includes selected engine/weights path bytes, fixed limits and recipe source; it does not hash GGUF bytes or attest the engine/weights.

gui_cancellation.observed_failure: A pending cancel-command HTTP response suppressed all state polling, leaving Stop visible after the host had finished. The initial browser run failed this outcome assertion.
gui_cancellation.fix: Allow state observations while only cancellation commands are pending, preserve the send gate until command completion, and advance the read generation after publishing the final cancellation snapshot.
gui_cancellation.coverage: Public browser holds cancellation response, confirms host cancellation before releasing a late tool reply, observes Stop disappearing/no tool edit, retains disabled Send until release, then completes an explicit new turn. Final desktop and phone screenshots inspected.

limits: No changes to the pure authority kernels or new extracted refinement claim.
Native implementations and I/O/configuration/schema attribution are trusted/tested adapters, not a sandbox for arbitrary native code or proof that a plugin tells the truth.
The real provider trial uses approved cloud inference on synthetic inputs; it does not validate local inference, cold installation, large local weights or complete R1.
